infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: RPiLEDConfig uses Bluetooth to talk to the Raspberry Pi whose LED you have read. Nothing else is scanned or stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RPiLEDConfig uses the camera to read the blinking LED on your Raspberry Pi, and a WiFi QR code when you choose to scan one. Nothing is recorded and no image leaves the phone.
